name: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission — EDGAR reference files (www.sec.gov/files)
access: HTTPS GET to www.sec.gov/files; no API key; declared User-Agent required

rate_limit.source: https://www.sec.gov/os/accessing-edgar-data ('Current max request rate: 10 requests/second'). This budget is shared with provider sec-edgar (same host and policy); ingestion makes one request per run.

failure_behavior: 429/403 or connection errors: bounded exponential backoff, then the run fails; the last snapshot stays in use and searches show its retrieval time.

datasets.description: Current CIK, company name, ticker and exchange for SEC-registered companies with exchange tickers
datasets.history_depth: Current snapshot only; history exists only from this system's first snapshot (CAP-INS-06)
datasets.update_frequency: Periodic; SEC 'does not guarantee accuracy or scope'
datasets.availability_rule: Each snapshot is available at its receipt time; no validity dates are inferred before the first snapshot.
datasets.rights_source: https://www.sec.gov/privacy (public information; cite SEC; do not use SEC seal or logos); redistribution not asserted here
datasets.rights_status: recorded from the capability register (CAP-INS-01, CAP-DATA-04); belongs with provider sec-edgar once that file is edited
